target_verification.reason: The official museum story and secondary plan reference agree on the I.M. Pei building, geometric roof and skylight language, white walls, glass and steel, central water courtyard, cloisters and interior-exterior continuity. The exact selected room is synthesized from these sources.

scene_goal: A complete concept interior of Suzhou Museum New Building showing one enclosed exhibition gallery, a real doorway and geometric window, a covered cloister, and a semi-open water courtyard beyond.
relationships: The enclosed gallery is the primary room and has four walls, floor and a pitched geometric ceiling.
A thick framed doorway connects the gallery to the cloister.
The cloister is semi-enclosed and frames the courtyard rather than becoming a floating strip.
A large geometric window and glazed opening connect the hall to the water courtyard.
The courtyard is open to sky and bounded by white walls, roof edges, water and garden rocks.
The stair is attached to real floor openings and lands at the hall/courtyard edge.

visual_language.style: contemporary Chinese museum architecture rooted in Suzhou garden sequencing
visual_language.lighting: soft daylight through geometric roof skylights and angled windows, with restrained warm gallery lighting
visual_language.mood: quiet, precise, contemplative, framed views and shifting perspectives

spatial_envelope.footprint: inferred L-shaped gallery and cloister around a rectangular water court
boundary_segments: open courtyard edge with parapet and planting
vertical_connections: two-story stair from lower gallery to upper landing

must_have: door opening with frame and threshold
covered cloister with columns and roof
hero interior view and cutaway overview
hard_constraints: Do not model furniture and props before the room envelope.
The enclosed gallery must read as a real room with continuous floor, walls and ceiling.
Every door, window, stair and courtyard connection must be a modeled opening or boundary condition.
Separate confirmed building characteristics from inferred dimensions and room arrangement.
soft_constraints: Use a 1:1 metric concept scale with a 22 m x 18 m selected composition.
Keep the geometry low-poly but structurally legible.
Use a cutaway/section camera to prove the building envelope.
uncertainties: The selected gallery arrangement and dimensions are inferred.
The hexagonal window and doorway are representative geometric openings, not claimed survey dimensions.
